dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Brewster is a beautiful, easy-to-love dog. She is eager to please and full of affection for caregivers. She attached to me and my family quickly and settled into a predictable routine of meals, walks, and sleep. She can be energetic at times and benefits from chew toys, walks in uncrowded areas, and positive reinforcement as well as peaceful moments to rest and decompress. In the short time we had her, she got used to sleeping in a crate at night. She enjoys pets and affection and rarely barks.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I love getting pets!

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!
dog.name: Brewster
